items.q: Yeah, yeah. Willy Bryant. And Lucky Millinder. They all, Lucky Millinder would jump up on top of the piano...

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Willy Bryant. And Lucky Millinder. They all, Lucky Millinder would jump up on top of the piano and on top of tables and all like that. Well, that wasn't music. But it worked on the people's eyes. People begin to hear with their eyes. Not with their ears, see?
